messages:
maria: Quick announce — we are GAing the SDK 'light adapters' today at 17:00 PT. :tada:

maria: This is the thin runtime shim we talked about for low-footprint embedding and chat clients. No breaking API surface.

maria: Two policy changes that go with the GA:
- New projects will have telemetry disabled by default (opt-in only).
- Existing projects will remain on the current setting for 60 days, after which we'll flip to opt-in-by-default unless teams opt-out via the org setting.

maria: Full details + migration guide here: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/light-adapters-ga and the migration checklist: https://go.redwood.ai/adapter-migrate

lin a: Congrats! Quick q: are there perf regressions for generation workloads?

maria: Lina: no regressions observed in our 95th pct latency tests. The adapters mainly change packaging and memory usage for small clients; large-server inference runs unchanged.

andy: For the migration, is there an automated org-level flag we can set?

maria: Yes — product exposes an admin toggle. CLI snippet:
```bash
redwood admin set-telemetry-default --org my-org --value opt-out
```

kai: Will we notify customers before we flip their projects?

maria: We'll send two emails + an in-console notice 30 days and 7 days before the flip. Also a changelog entry and a blog post.

olivia: Docs note: I added an FAQ entry about "what telemetry collects" and a diff of the SDK payloads. Please review: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/telemetry-faq

deploy-bot: release/light-adapters v1.0.0 deployed to edge clusters at 2026-03-23T17:00:01Z — status: success :white_check_mark:

priya: Action items for eng: 1) confirm samples updated, 2) add E2E that toggles admin flag, 3) coordinate customer comms with growth.

maria: Thanks — added to the ga checklist and assigned owners. If anyone sees anything odd, drop in #eng-runtime or ping me directly. :thumbsup:

tom: Thanks for the heads up. I'll kick off the SRE runbook review this afternoon.

maria: Appreciate it. Will follow up with the postmortem-style rollout notes if we see any anomalies.

kai: tiny nit — the docs link 404ed for me for a sec, fixed now.

maria: Good catch, Kai. All links should be live now.

olivia: I'll push a short blurb to the docs changelog after lunch.

andy: ping me if you need a comms draft for enterprise customers.

maria: Will do. END THREAD
